set.body:
Purpose:
Pilot Cats Core where applicative error accumulation materially improves BIDS validation.

Scope:
- Add Cats Core to the BIDS crossProject only after the F0 admission contract is accepted.
- Use ValidatedNec/NonEmptyChain internally for independent checks in the highest-value surfaces: datatype/entity specifications, table header/row validation, and query construction.
- Keep genuinely sequential parsing and dependent checks as Either; convert deliberately between the two phases.
- Preserve deterministic error ordering and domain-specific BidsIssue values.
- Use Traverse or syntax only where it removes BidsEither-style bespoke traversal after the dependency has already earned admission.
- Avoid public Cats datatypes unless the API review demonstrates a durable advantage over a BIDS-specific result type.
- Record a keep/reject decision with before/after code and test evidence.

Acceptance:
- Multi-defect fixtures return every independent issue, not just the first.
- Existing single-error compatibility methods still return a deterministic primary error.
- BidsEither is removed only if no longer justified; replacing it alone is not success.
- No pure domain model gains IO/F parameters.
- BIDS JVM and Scala.js suites pass warning-clean.
set.title: BIDS F2: accumulate independent validation with Cats Core
